Subject: MAP kickoff — security acceptance, SOC 2 / SIG checklist, DPA questions

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the demo last week — team liked the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to capture the security/compliance items we need to close: SOC 2 report, SIG/CAIQ matrix, DPA with clear retention language, and an explicit acceptance criterion for the MAP that our security team can sign off on. I've attached a short list of questions to help scope evidence intake (ClearHorizons-MAP-questions.pdf).

Two clarifying items from our side:
- Retention: our legal wants a max-data-retention window of 90 days for hosted deployments; for any dedicated/private deployment we need contractual retention guarantees and a way to audit deletion.
- SOC 2: we need the latest Type II report and a short summary of subcontractors.

Could you share a proposed MAP with milestone-level acceptance criteria (evidence required per gate) and an estimate for how long evidence intake + security review usually takes? Also please list what artifacts you can provide immediately.

If you prefer a short call with our security lead (cc'd on procurement), we're happy to schedule.

Best,
Maria Ortiz\Security Program Manager\ClearHorizons

Attachment: ClearHorizons-MAP-questions.pdf (list of 7 targeted questions)

From: avery_johnson@redwood.ai

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security acceptance, SOC 2 / SIG checklist, DPA questions

Maria — thanks for the clear list and the thoughtful questions. Attaching an initial MAP draft that maps each security gate to evidence we can provide and an expected review cadence (MAP_v1.pdf). High level answers up front:

- Retention: Hosted API defaults to 30 days for inference logs and 90 days for minimal analytics; we can contractually limit inference context retention to 90 days as you requested. For Dedicated and Private, we offer configurable retention policies and contractual deletion SLAs; we can include audit hooks (deletion event logs) in the DPA.
- SOC 2: we can share our most recent Type II report and a summary of our service providers (Auth0, FastCloud infra provider).
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll provide a completed matrix and a short Q&A doc for the 10 highest-risk controls you've flagged.

Proposed milestones (summary):
1) Evidence upload (0–7 days): SOC2, SIG matrix, DPA draft, retention statement.
2) Security review (7–21 days): Q&A cycle, clarifications on retention & encryption in transit/at-rest.
3) Final acceptance (21–28 days): security sign-off + procurement countersign.

If that timeline looks OK I can loop in Legal and Product Security to finalize the DPA language that covers audit logs & deletion proof. Suggest a 30-min sync Thurs if you want to walk the MAP together.

Thanks — attaching MAP_v1.pdf.

— Avery Johnson\Senior Account Executive\Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (proposed MAP with milestone-level evidence checklist)

Avery — drafting language and attaching a DPA draft and the latest SOC 2 packet for review. Summary of proposed acceptance criteria to include in MAP: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood to provide most recent Type II and an executive summary. Acceptance: ClearHorizons' security confirms report covers relevant time window and no critical control failures.
2) SIG/CAIQ: Completed matrix + targeted answers for high-risk controls. Acceptance: no open high-risk items after 2 Q&A cycles.
3) DPA & Retention: DPA to state hosted inference context retention <= 90 days (customer-configurable retention for Dedicated/Private). For deletion proof: Redwood will provide a signed deletion certificate plus event log entries (timestamped) exported from our retention service; for Dedicated/Private we will provide customer-accessible deletion events if running in customer's VPC. Acceptance: procurement/legal sign-off on DPA and sample deletion certificate.

4) Operational controls: encryption in transit/at rest, key management notes (KMS integration options), and monitoring/tracing hooks required for their audit. Acceptance: Security confirms encryption & KMS answers meet baseline.

I attached: redwood-dpa-draft.docx, SOC2-report-2025.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx. Ben — can you confirm the path to the shared folder so I can give ClearHorizons access? Neha — please confirm the subcontractor list and any evidence that needs redaction.

I'll iterate quickly; once we have the DPA wording I suggest sending a single package to Maria and offering a 30-min technical clarifier slot.

Laura Bennett\Head of Legal, Contracts\Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dpa-draft.docx, SOC2-report-2025.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-responses.xlsx

Thanks Laura and Avery — that level of detail is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our security lead:

- For the deletion certificate: we need the event log to include the object id (or range), timestamp, and the user/service that executed deletion. A signed PDF certificate is fine for legal.
- For Dedicated vs Private: we want to confirm whether Redwood will commit to providing the same signed deletion certificate for a self-hosted (on-prem) deployment where Redwood's control plane is not present. If not, we need wording that clarifies the customer's responsibility for deletion proof in an air-gapped environment.

Procurement is also asking for an expected calendar: can you confirm the evidence intake window and security review estimate in calendar days from the MAP acceptance? We aim to close by the end of October.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Maria

Maria — quick operational answers to your questions:

1) Deletion proof format: we will deliver two artifacts for hosted/Dedicated: (a) signed deletion certificate PDF with summary metadata, and (b) CSV export of deletion events: object_id, timestamp (ISO8601), initiated_by (service-account id). For Dedicated/Private on customer-managed infra we will provide the signed certificate where possible; if Redwood cannot access the control plane, the MAP will include a customer-delivered deletion confirmation path (we provide the template and verification steps).

2) Evidence intake + review timeline: from when we hand over artifacts, typical security review is 10–14 business days including one clarification round. Proposed schedule to meet your end-of-October close:
- 9/27: Finalized MAP + DPA draft to ClearHorizons (tomorrow).
- 9/28–10/04: Evidence intake window (you confirm receipt & completeness).
- 10/05–10/19: Security review & 1 Q&A cycle.
- 10/20–10/27: Legal & procurement negotiation / countersign.

If that runway works, I'll upload the SOC2 and SIG matrix to the shared drive and grant your security lead access. Also adding a 30-min technical clarifier on 9/29 — I'll propose times.
